mission: One ordinary Sorcerer -> Wizard -> Arch Mage promotion replay, with journal, character/inventory effects, ordinary Save/Resume, and cleanup.

neutral_initial_scene.observation: New Game/Continue modal over the dim School of Sorcery stone-door scene. Four staged Sorcerers are not yet visible because the modal covers the scene. A conspicuous toast already reads: Use: map event 9000 of place '29': nothing comes of it.

staging.party: Four base Sorcerers near the School of Sorcery Thomas Grey door; high health/funds.
staging.items: Six golem pieces (IDs 639, 641-645) and Divine Intervention book (ID 487) were disclosed as initial staged inventory.
staging.story: Light99 was disclosed as staged map-entry state; this replay does not claim campaign acquisition or Pit/Breeding Zone travel.

timeline: New Game opened the School of Sorcery with the four staged Sorcerers, 100000 gold and 50 provisions.
Ordinary G at Thomas Grey offered Wizard promotion: collect six golem pieces, assemble the golem, and return. The Current Quests view showed the Wizard errand.

Opened the Golem companion conversation separately for each ordinary topic. The six visible choices assembled torso, left leg, right leg, left arm, right arm and head; the seventh choice visibly confirmed all parts together and instructed a return to Master Grey.
Returned to Thomas through ordinary interaction. Wizard promotion completed visibly; the dialogue said the Sorcerers became Wizards and the golem was animated.
Thomas then offered Arch Mage promotion: find Divine Intervention in the Breeding Zone in the Pit and return. Current Quests showed the Arch Mage errand.
Before handover, ordinary Inventory showed one staged Divine Intervention book in the party pack. Reopened Thomas and selected the Arch Mage topic with the book present.

Completion dialogue visibly recognized the book, created a copy and said 'You may keep the copy'. Character view showed Roderick · Arch Mage; gold visibly increased to 110000. The Arch Mage errand cleared from Current Quests.

After completion, ordinary Inventory still visibly showed one Divine Intervention copy (Spellbook, Worth 10000 gold, Study). This is retained book behavior; no subtraction was visible and the completion text explicitly says to keep the copy.
Pressed ordinary F to save. Visible toast: Save: Saved the session to slot 'session' at 1168-01-01 16:48. Used Menu -> Load saved expedition -> Discard changes and load.
After Resume, Character still visibly showed Roderick · Arch Mage and Inventory still visibly showed the Divine Intervention copy.

acceptance.book_effect: pass_visible_retained_copy; source-correct retention recorded, no claim that the item is subtracted
acceptance.ordinary_controls: pass; visible game UI, conversation, character, inventory, menu and save/load controls

limitations: Six golem parts, the Divine Intervention book and Light99 were disclosed staged state; this is a replay of the ordinary promotion chain, not evidence of acquiring them through the campaign or traveling to Pit/Breeding Zone.

The initial and later world views retained the visible 'Use: map event 9000 of place 29: nothing comes of it' toast. It was conspicuous but did not prevent the disclosed Light-path Wizard/Arch Mage chain.
This report scopes only the Wizard/Arch Mage chain; other quest hooks are out of scope.
The original capture sidecars record frame correlation as uncertain when the frame changed during capture; the listed PNGs are the original visible captures.
publication_note: Original observer report preserved in the operator temporary evidence. This published copy uses local retained capture paths; Git review identity is recorded in Den. The observed chain predates the independent timer-accounting, chest and silent-lifecycle-feedback corrections, which have focused regressions.
